settings.minecraftInitial.hint: options.txt is not written when an instance is created. Instances that have never been launched use the latest initial options from just before the first launch. settings.minecraftInitial.keybinds.versi: These options are meant for Minecraft 1.13 and later (1.12 and older are not supported). The list is based on the latest version, so controls that do not exist in an instance's version are not written. Mouse bindings can record up to the 8 buttons Minecraft allows (left, right, middle, and 4-8).

settings.factoryResetHint: Deletes accounts, instances, Minecraft files, Java, skins, settings, and caches, then returns the app to a fresh state. The Fledge app itself are kept. The app restarts when this finishes.
settings.factoryResetConfirmBody:
All of the following will be deleted.

ﾂｷ Microsoft accounts
ﾂｷ Instances (worlds, mods, and game settings)
ﾂｷ Minecraft files and libraries
ﾂｷ Installed Java
ﾂｷ Skins
ﾂｷ Launcher settings
ﾂｷ Caches and logs

Minecraft will be closed if it is running. This cannot be undone.
settings.factoryReset.progressHint: The app will restart automatically when this finishes.
settings.uninstallHint: Deletes Fledge itself and the Data and Instances folders beside it, including Start menu shortcuts. This cannot be undone.
settings.uninstallConfirmBody:
All of the following will be deleted.

ﾂｷ Fledge itself (the install folder)
ﾂｷ Data (accounts, settings, Minecraft files, Java, skins, and more)
ﾂｷ Instances (worlds, mods, and game settings)

Backups saved in another folder are kept.
Minecraft will be closed if it is running. The app will close when this finishes.

onboarding.termsBody:
By installing or using this app, you agree to these terms.

Fledge is an unofficial Minecraft launcher. It is not an official Mojang / Microsoft product. The source code is published under the GNU GPL-3.0.

You agree to follow the Minecraft EULA and Microsoft's terms of service, and not to use this app for prohibited modifications, cheating, or other violations. You are responsible for complying with the licenses of mods you install and for managing your saves and settings.

This app is provided as is, with no warranty against data loss, launch failures, or similar problems.
onboarding.tutorialOfferBody: A short guide to Fledge highlights buttons and menus on each screen. You can also see how to create an instance and the settings that are unique to Fledge.
onboarding.tutorial.nav.title: Sidebar
onboarding.tutorial.nav.body: Use the menu on the left to open Home, Content, Skins, and Settings. The collapse button switches it to icons only.
onboarding.tutorial.instance.title: Creating an instance
onboarding.tutorial.instance.body:
From the + on Home, pick a version and loader to create a new instance (a launch setup).

On the Content screen you can also create a setup from a modpack or mod. Find one you like and create an instance from it.
onboarding.tutorial.news.title: News
onboarding.tutorial.news.body: News appears on the right side of Home. Check update notes and important announcements here.
onboarding.tutorial.skin.title: Skins
onboarding.tutorial.skin.body: Choose how your character looks on the Skins screen. Switch the default skin or register an image from here.
onboarding.tutorialTargetMissing: This item is not on screen right now. Continue, or open the matching screen and try again.
onboarding.tutorial.settingsAppTheme.bod: Fledge's own theme settings. Choose light or dark, a season theme, and an accent color to set the look of the launcher.
onboarding.tutorial.settingsMinecraftIni: A feature unique to Fledge. Set starting game options such as language, volume, and render distance in advance. They apply to new worlds and the first launch.
onboarding.tutorial.settingsResources.bo: Settings for important files, including the data folder. Know where these live so you can manage instances and saves.

privacy.noticeBody:
Fledge does not collect information for ads, analytics, or crash reports.

Account sign-in uses official Microsoft / Mojang services. Game and mod downloads use official or distributor APIs only when needed.

To show avatars, your account UUID may be sent to a third-party service (mc-heads.net). Leave Discord Rich Presence off, or turn it on only when you want it.

See PRIVACY.md in the repository for details.
settings.privacyNote:
Fledge does not show ads or collect usage analytics. It does not send crash reports.

ﾂｷ Avatars: your UUID may be sent to mc-heads.net so a face can be shown (a Microsoft image URL is preferred when one is available).
ﾂｷ Discord Rich Presence: off by default. Status is sent to local Discord only when it is on.
ﾂｷ Modrinth / Mojang and similar services: ordinary API requests are made only when searching, downloading, or launching.
